about: Where a move may start or end: for each view type that takes addresses, what an address is (as a problem names it: 'is not <what> of <type> "<id>"') and the forms it accepts in a frame's state of the view (the run's setup merged with the frame's). An address is valid when any form accepts it. scripts/validate.mjs reads this file and CodeBite's WalkthroughsMatchSamplesTest reads its copy; the player's locate(at) draws what it accepts. A new address for a view is an entry here plus its locate.

forms.index: a whole number, an index into the state's list `list`
forms.key: a string or a number naming an item of the state's list `list` by text (4 and "4" are one key): the item's `field`, or the item itself when there is no `field`
forms.pair: [i, j]: i an index into the state's list `list`, j an index into that item's list `inner` (the item itself when there is no `inner`)
forms.edge: [from, to]: an edge of the state's list `list` by its from and to ids (by text), either order when the view's config sets `directed` to false

graph.what: a node id or a [from, to] edge
